description: Desktop Commander ToolSearch returned 'No matching deferred tools found' on first attempt in scheduled task, causing step-02-approve.md to fail early. Tool became available on second ToolSearch attempt. Workflow designed to require Desktop Commander for all Slack operations, but tool initialization was not guaranteed upfront.
correction: Desktop Commander should be loaded explicitly at task start, or ToolSearch should retry automatically if critical tools are missing. Alternatively, step-02-approve should check tool availability before proceeding to Slack operations.
systemic_fix: Add explicit ToolSearch with retry logic to content-pipeline workflows before any Slack operations. Document Desktop Commander availability assumption in step-02-approve.md.
